cases.row: Shapes: highlight box and filled box over video (EL4a)
cases.description: A stroked highlight box fading in, and a filled rounded box, drawn by the engine's rasteriser.
A translucent yellow marker highlight over picture: its edges keep their colour.
A filled, stroked ellipse turning 0 to 90 degrees: the rotation-safe raster never clips it.

cases.row: Shapes: arrow and dashed underline segments (EL4a)
cases.description: An arrow pointing at a spot and a dashed underline, placed by their ends, one moving by keyframe.
A dashed rectangle and a dotted ellipse: the stroke patterns walk the outline.

cases.row: Shapes: stars and polygons by their knobs (EL5)
cases.description: A seven-point star with deep points, then a hexagon: generators read knobs and fixed geometry.
A curved arrow bowing up with a dot at its tail and a head at its tip; its bounds include the bow.

cases.row: Shapes: speech bubble with its tail (EL5)
cases.description: A white speech bubble with an outline and its tail near the right.

cases.row: Shapes: rings and frames with holes (EL5)
cases.description: A circle frame and a photo frame: their holes show the video beneath (even-odd fill).
A check icon placed by id, then the catalogue's warning symbol: outlines drawn with round caps.

cases.row: Shapes: a marker multiplied over video (EL5)
cases.description: A yellow marker in multiply blend: the picture beneath darkens through it instead of washing out.

cases.row: Shapes: numbered badges and a burst label (EL5)
cases.description: A red step badge numbered 2, then a yellow SALE burst: the label is drawn by the engine inside the shape, centred on its ink.
